quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully putting together an idea or a plan?
quests.question: Formulate
quests.hint: Think about carefully putting together a clever plan for how your team will win a game.
quests.explanation: Formulate means to carefully put together an idea or plan. We formulate a clever plan to win a game!
quests.funFact: Formulating a good plan ahead of time can make a big challenge feel much easier!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a thoughtful guess that you can test with an experiment?
quests.question: Hypothesize
quests.hint: Think about guessing which plant will grow tallest, and then testing it to find out.
quests.explanation: Hypothesize means to make a thoughtful guess to test. We hypothesize which plant will grow tallest, then test it!
quests.funFact: Scientists hypothesize an answer first, then run experiments to see if they are right!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for drawing a simple picture that explains how something works?
quests.question: Diagram
quests.hint: Think about drawing a simple picture with arrows to show how a plant grows from a seed.
quests.explanation: Diagram means to draw a simple picture that explains something. We diagram how a plant grows from a seed!
quests.funFact: A clear diagram can explain an idea faster than a whole page of words!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for recording information neatly using a graph or table?
quests.question: Chart
quests.hint: Think about recording the weather every day this week using a colorful graph.
quests.explanation: Chart means to record information using a graph or table. We chart the weather every day this week!
quests.funFact: Charting information over time helps you easily spot patterns, like rainy weeks!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for writing down information carefully so it is not forgotten?
quests.question: Document
quests.hint: Think about carefully writing down each stage of how a caterpillar changes into a butterfly.
quests.explanation: Document means to write down information so it is not forgotten. We document each stage of a caterpillar's change!
quests.funFact: Documenting your observations carefully is exactly what real scientists do every day!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully storing information or objects to keep for a long time?
quests.question: Archive
quests.hint: Think about carefully storing your favorite old drawings in a special box to keep forever.
quests.explanation: Archive means to carefully store things to keep for a long time. We archive our favorite old drawings in a special box!
quests.funFact: Museums archive old, precious objects so people can still learn from them years later!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully choosing and organizing a special collection?
quests.question: Curate
quests.hint: Think about carefully choosing your very best drawings to display on one special wall.
quests.explanation: Curate means to carefully choose and organize a collection. We curate our best drawings for one special wall!
quests.funFact: A museum worker who curates a collection carefully chooses which items to display!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting something on display for people to see?
quests.question: Exhibit
quests.hint: Think about putting your best science project on a table for the whole school to see.
quests.explanation: Exhibit means to put something on display for people to see. We exhibit our science project for the whole school!
quests.funFact: A museum exhibit lets many visitors enjoy and learn from special collections!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for showing off something special so others can notice it?
quests.question: Showcase
quests.hint: Think about proudly showing off your finished art project during a class open house.
quests.explanation: Showcase means to show off something special. We showcase our finished art at a class open house!
quests.funFact: A talent show is a fun way for people to showcase their very best skills!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for removing a cover to reveal something new for the first time?
quests.question: Unveil
quests.hint: Think about pulling off a cloth to reveal a brand new statue for the very first time.
quests.explanation: Unveil means to remove a cover to reveal something new. A town might unveil a brand new statue!
quests.funFact: Unveiling something special is often done with excitement in front of a crowd!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for performing or appearing in public for the very first time?
quests.question: Debut
quests.hint: Think about a young singer performing on a big stage for the very first time ever.
quests.explanation: Debut means to perform in public for the first time. A young singer can debut on a big stage!
quests.funFact: A debut performance is often remembered as an exciting and nerve-wracking first step!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for showing a movie or show for the very first time?
quests.question: Premiere
quests.hint: Think about a brand new movie being shown in theaters for the very first time ever.
quests.explanation: Premiere means to show a movie or show for the first time. A new movie can premiere in theaters!
quests.funFact: Fans often wait excitedly for months for their favorite movie to premiere!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sending out a program so many people can watch or listen?
quests.question: Broadcast
quests.hint: Think about a news show being sent out on TV so families everywhere can watch it.
quests.explanation: Broadcast means to send out a program so many people can watch. The news is broadcast on TV every night!
quests.funFact: A single broadcast can reach millions of people all watching at the very same time!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sending a signal or message from one place to another?
quests.question: Transmit
quests.hint: Think about a radio tower sending music signals all the way to the radio in your car.
quests.explanation: Transmit means to send a signal from one place to another. A tower can transmit music to your radio!
quests.funFact: Signals can transmit incredibly fast, even all the way from outer space!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for passing along a message or object from person to person?
quests.question: Relay
quests.hint: Think about passing a baton quickly from one runner to the next during a relay race.
quests.explanation: Relay means to pass along a message or object. Runners relay a baton from one to the next!
quests.funFact: A relay race is won by a whole team working together, not just one runner!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sending someone or something off quickly to a place?
quests.question: Dispatch
quests.hint: Think about sending a fire truck off quickly the moment there is an emergency call.
quests.explanation: Dispatch means to send someone or something off quickly. A fire truck is dispatched during an emergency call!
quests.funFact: Emergency workers dispatch help as quickly as possible whenever someone needs it!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for bringing something to the exact place it needs to go?
quests.question: Deliver
quests.hint: Think about a mail carrier bringing a special package right to your front door.
quests.explanation: Deliver means to bring something to where it needs to go. A mail carrier can deliver a package to your door!
quests.funFact: Delivering mail and packages safely takes careful routes and a lot of planning!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sharing something out among a whole group of people?
quests.question: Distribute
quests.hint: Think about handing out one cupcake to every single classmate at a party.
quests.explanation: Distribute means to share something out among a group. We distribute a cupcake to every classmate at a party!
quests.funFact: Distributing things fairly makes sure everyone in a group gets an equal share!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully giving out a certain amount to each person?
quests.question: Allocate
quests.hint: Think about carefully giving each team member exactly the same number of art supplies.
quests.explanation: Allocate means to carefully give out an amount to each person. We allocate art supplies fairly to each team member!
quests.funFact: Allocating resources fairly is an important skill for working well as a team!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for deciding which things are most important to do first?
quests.question: Prioritize
quests.hint: Think about deciding to finish your homework before you play your favorite game.
quests.explanation: Prioritize means to decide what is most important to do first. We prioritize our homework before playtime!
quests.funFact: Prioritizing your tasks can help even a busy day feel calm and organized!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a process simpler and smoother so it works better?
quests.question: Streamline
quests.hint: Think about rearranging your morning routine so getting ready for school takes less time.
quests.explanation: Streamline means to make a process simpler and smoother. We streamline our morning routine to save time!
quests.funFact: Streamlining even a small routine can give you extra minutes in your busy day!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for changing something so it works in the very best possible way?
quests.question: Optimize
quests.hint: Think about rearranging your desk so all your school supplies are easy to reach.
quests.explanation: Optimize means to change something so it works in the best way. We optimize our desk so supplies are easy to reach!
quests.funFact: Optimizing a small routine can save you time and effort every single day!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully finding and fixing the cause of a problem?
quests.question: Troubleshoot
quests.hint: Think about carefully checking each part of a toy to find out why it stopped working.
quests.explanation: Troubleshoot means to carefully find and fix the cause of a problem. We troubleshoot a toy to see why it stopped working!
quests.funFact: Troubleshooting step by step helps you find a solution instead of just guessing!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully adjusting a tool so it measures correctly?
quests.question: Calibrate
quests.hint: Think about carefully adjusting a scale so it shows the exact right weight.
quests.explanation: Calibrate means to carefully adjust a tool so it measures correctly. We calibrate a scale to show the exact weight!
quests.funFact: Scientists calibrate their tools carefully before every important experiment!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making small, careful changes to make something better?
quests.question: Refine
quests.hint: Think about making a few small, careful changes to polish up your finished story.
quests.explanation: Refine means to make small changes to make something better. We refine our story to make it even better!
quests.funFact: Refining your work little by little can turn something good into something great!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making something even better or stronger than before?
quests.question: Enhance
quests.hint: Think about adding a splash of bright color to enhance a plain, simple drawing.
quests.explanation: Enhance means to make something even better than before. We enhance a plain drawing with bright colors!
quests.funFact: A few small, thoughtful changes can really enhance any project you are working on!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a sound much stronger or louder?
quests.question: Amplify
quests.hint: Think about how a microphone can amplify your voice so a whole room can hear you.
quests.explanation: Amplify means to make a sound much stronger or louder. A microphone can amplify your voice for a whole room!
quests.funFact: Amplifiers are used at concerts to help music reach every single person in a big crowd!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making two or more things happen at exactly the same time?
quests.question: Synchronize
quests.hint: Think about a whole dance team moving in perfectly matching steps at exactly the same moment.
quests.explanation: Synchronize means to make things happen at the same time. A dance team can synchronize their steps perfectly!
quests.funFact: Synchronized swimmers practice for hours so every movement matches perfectly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for blending different sounds or ideas together so they fit nicely?
quests.question: Harmonize
quests.hint: Think about a choir blending many different voices together into one beautiful song.
quests.explanation: Harmonize means to blend different sounds together so they fit nicely. A choir can harmonize many voices into one song!
quests.funFact: When voices harmonize well together, they can create a truly beautiful sound!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for reaching the final, most exciting part after a long build-up?
quests.question: Culminate
quests.hint: Think about how a whole year of school projects can culminate in one big final show.
quests.explanation: Culminate means to reach the final, exciting part after a long build-up. A year of hard work can culminate in one big show!
quests.funFact: A grand fireworks finale is a wonderful way for a celebration to culminate!
